what: On open, the cover (logo) turns on in 1s, and 1s later scattered photos land one by one at .147s intervals, each at its own tilted spot. .4s after the last photo, the big center photo, at 1.1 scale and tilted 10°, settles into place from transparent in .8s. At the same moment the cover turns off and the remaining photos grow to 1.17 scale in .64s and are pushed out to the spread positions — the Hero photo collage. fx:reveal is sent 2.5s after start

options.start: Time (sec) when photo placement starts, default 1
options.land: Seconds until the middle photo settles down after the last photo, default .4
options.reveal: Time in seconds after start to send fx:reveal, default 2.5 — the consumer turns on the title and menu here
options.session: If true, from the second visit in the same session it skips the build-up and shows the final state with a fade of (default 1) seconds
options.fade: Seconds for the end shape to rise on the second session visit, default 1
options.--fx-at: (per piece css) placement transform — centered, e.g. translate(-60%, -43%) rotate(-3deg)
options.--fx-out: (css per piece) transform at the spread position — if absent, scale(1.17) at --fx-at
options.--fx-center-from·--fx-center-at: (css) Center photo start/end transform, default translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.1) rotate(10deg) → translate(-50%,-50%)
options.[data-fx-part=item·center·mark]: Photos to scatter (item, stacking upward in order) · big center photo (center) · initial cover (mark, optional)

use: Logo
note: The original is a CSS transition that swaps classes at each time point, so this works the same way (no GSAP). The stage size is decided by the user — the original scaled a 1366×780 (phone 375×683) stage to fit the screen

from.where: index.html .sk-intro (original .introBox step01·step02: logo opacity 1s, nine photos fadeIn(0) in turn 147ms apart with .64s transition, item10 at 147×9+400ms with .8s, step02.hide at 1.17×, fvShow after 2.5s)
